zatfaqdz.baseName: Neo 36PCS Christmas Tree Ornaments Set - Dark Red
zatfaqdz.variantName: Neo 36PCS Christmas Tree Ornaments Set - Dark Red
zatfaqdz.sourceDescription: Transform your home into a festive wonderland with our stunning Neo Christmas Tree Ornament Decorations. Perfect for Christmas, parties, and even Halloween tree decorations, these dazzling baubles and glitter balls bring sparkle and sophistication to any setting. Whether you're decking the halls or hosting a holiday event, these copper-orange ornaments will elevate your décor with timeless elegance. Add a magical touch to your festive celebrations with these sparkling Christmas ball ornaments. Whether you prefer a traditional, modern, or whimsical theme, our Christmas bauble decorations are designed to make your tree shine brighter than ever. For decorative use only. This product is not a toy. Keep ornaments, hanging strings, hooks and any small components out of reach of young children and pets due to potential choking, ingestion and entanglement hazards. Adult supervision is recommended when children are present. Ensure all decorations are securely attached to the Christmas tree to reduce the risk of items falling. Discontinue use of any ornament that becomes cracked, broken or develops sharp edges. Keep decorations away from open flames, candles, heaters and other direct heat sources. Take care when attaching and removing ornaments and avoid positioning them where they could create a trip or entanglement hazard. Retain packaging and product information for future reference. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom

rrrt00m9.baseName: Christmas Village Electric Rotating Christmas Tree Stand for 7ft Trees - Green
rrrt00m9.variantName: Christmas Village Electric Rotating Christmas Tree Stand for 7ft Trees - Green
rrrt00m9.sourceDescription: Display your Christmas tree from every angle with the Christmas Village Electric Rotating Christmas Tree Stand in Green. This motorised stand completes a full 360-degree rotation every 72 seconds and offers three operating modes: lights with rotation, lights only, or off. Designed for indoor use, the sturdy five-point star base features an ABS plastic housing and supports Christmas trees up to 7ft tall and weighing up to 35kg. Three included adjustable caps accommodate tree pole diameters from 1.9cm to 3.2cm. Supplied with a UK plug featuring a 5A fuse and a 1.5m power cable for convenient setup. Product Dimensions: Height (H): 20.5cm, Width (W): 65cm, Depth (D): 65cm. Product Weight: 1.79kg. Includes 1 electric rotating Christmas tree stand and 3 adjustable caps. For indoor use only. Read all instructions before use. Place on a flat, stable surface. Ensure the christmas tree is securely fitted before operating. Suitable for trees up to 7ft tall and 35kg maximum weight. Keep away from water and heat sources. Do not operate with a damaged power cord or plug. Switch off and unplug before adjusting or moving the stand. Keep out of reach of children. HSI Global Ltd - 9 George Square Suite 320 Glasgow, G2 1QQ
